explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration that states this result. `mulInvariantCoordinateVectorField` is the library's own definition (TauCeti/Geometry/Lie/Exponential/ParameterDependence.lean:67), and Mathlib does not mention it. It takes the left-invariant vector field generated by `v`, evaluates it at the point `(extChartAt I 1).symm y`, and expresses the result in chart coordinates with `tangentCoordChange`. The proof combines linearity of the coordinate change (`map_add`) with Mathlib's `mulInvariantVectorField_add` (Mathlib/Geometry/Manifold/GroupLieAlgebra.lean), which says the left-invariant vector field depends additively on the Lie-algebra element. It also needs a `change` step to unfold the definitional model-space conversion. That is two ingredients plus unfolding the library's coordinate construction, not a single instantiation of one Mathlib declaration. Most of the content lies in the library's own definition, so it is neither a duplicate nor a special case.
